_meta.description: Line 5's stations in order from Kapurbawdi, as MMRDA's revised plan of 2026 has them. 'stations' is the line itself; 'spur_stations' is the Line 5A spur from Bhoirwadi to Ulhasnagar (along_m measured on the spur); 'dropped_stations' were on the 2017 route and are not in the revised plan. Positions to the Ulhas river bridge come from MMRDA's alignment file (March 2025, verified); past it, from the tentative key plan in MMRDA's tender documents of March 2026 (reported, good to about 50 m), with the 2025 point under location.earlier where a station moved. Both by scripts/build-alignment-line5.py. Kongaon West is new and has no published position. 'phase': 1 Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka, 2 to Kongaon West, 3 Durgadi to Kalyan, '5A' the spur. 'eia_chainage_m' is the chainage in MMRDA's Phase 1 environmental report (Sep 2023), which does not match the distances between the station points (for example Kalher to Purna: 0.83 km in the report, about 2 km apart on the map); kept as published. 'keyplan_chainage_m' is the chainage on the key plan, from the corridor start at the bridge (Phase 3) or the spur start (5A). 'same_site_as' names a station of another line at the same place, with the distance between the two points.

stations.name: Kapurbawdi

location.method: OpenStreetMap's Kapurbawdi Station (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/8342841400), on the Line 4 viaduct over Ghodbunder Road, where Line 5's tracks run alongside; checked on satellite imagery by the owner (Google Maps) and on Esri imagery, 2026-10-09. The point is 11 m from the line.

earlier.basis: MMRDA's alignment file of March 2025, which puts it on the curve east of Ghodbunder Road, where there is no station

interchanges.notes: MMRDA's press release (May 2026) puts the Line 4 interchange 'at Balkhum (Kapurbawadi)'; its Phase 1 environmental report (Sep 2023) says Kapurbawdi station is built as part of Line 4.

construction_status.value: Built as part of Metro Line 4; shared by Lines 4 and 5
construction_status.notes: MMRDA's Phase 1 environmental report (Sep 2023), Table 2.3: Kapurbawdi station is built as part of Metro Line 4 and is not one of Line 5's six Phase 1 stations.

revised_plan_2026.value: Kept: the interchange station shared with Line 4

stations.notes: Line 5's first station and its interchange with Line 4. It is built under Line 4's contracts, so MMRDA does not count it among Line 5's stations; the site lists it as Line 5's station 1 (owner's decision, 2026-10-09). Not in the 15-station list on MMRDA's Line 5 page.

street_view.note: Looking south at the station from about 110 m north, on Ghodbunder Road. Picked by the owner, 2026-10-09. A link only: Google's imagery is not copied onto the site.

location.method: Not published. MMRDA lists it after Kon Gaon in Phase 2 but gives no position; the 2025 alignment file has only one Kon Gaon point.

stations.notes: New in the revised plan. Its order is MMRDA's list order; whether it lies before or after Kon Gaon on the ground is not published. Other reports call the two stations Kongan West and Kongan East.

stations.name: Durgadi

location.method: Tentative route in MMRDA's tender documents of March 2026 for the general consultant of Line 5A (key plan posted on X by Arindam Mahapatra; that tender was cancelled on 19 Aug 2026). Position traced from the key plan and placed on the map with Kala Talao and the Ulhas river bridge as control points; good to about 50 m. Key plan chainage 550 m; along_m adds it to the distance from Kapurbawdi to the corridor start at the bridge.
